Subject: Exec: Competitive & OKR pulse — QBR prep (pricing, model launches, positioning)

Team,

Quick morning brief ahead of QBR prep — pulling together a short competitive & OKR pulse so we can lock slides by EOD Tue Oct 20. TL;DR: two pricing moves and one model release we need to call out; our Cost/Token OKR is behind target and we should surface mitigation + customer-facing messaging.

Competitive highlights (quick bullets):
- ArborAI: public announcement this morning — 15% permanent list price cut on their hosted Gen API for high-throughput plan. They framed it as "scale-first pricing" in the blog. Impact: potential churn risk for 3 mid-market customers that prioritize unit cost.
- Nimbus AI: quietly released Nimbus-3 (13B) with out-of-the-box INT8 quantized weights and a low-latency hosting SKU. Early benchmarks show ~1.6x throughput vs Nimbus-2 at same latency. They pushed partner pricing to marketplaces this week.
- CloudX Labs: soft launch of an instruction-tuned 7B model optimized for short-sequence completions; positioning focuses on dev ergonomics and embedded usage.

OKR implications (where we are):
- OKR: Cost/Token Reduction (Q4 target -18%) — current run-rate improvement: -6%. Root cause: onboarding latency on quantized model families + conservative batching defaults in hosted runtime.
- OKR: Model Onboarding Velocity — missed two onboarding milestones (internal validation & perf profile) for open-models pipeline — backlog affects pricing experiments.

Asks / Owners for QBR slides:
1) Pricing impact summary (slide + short narrative) — owner: @laura_bennett — include potential revenue exposure for named accounts and recommended short-term counteroffers (credits/term deals).
2) Product/Runtime mitigation plan (slide) — owner: @markus_klein — list 30/60-day fixes (tuning batching, KV cache heuristics, routing to cheaper variants).
3) Model release tracking & benchmark plan (slide + ops checklist) — owner: @maya_srinivasan — cover Nimbus-3 and CloudX 7B; include planned evals.
4) Sales playbook update (one-pager) — owner: @rishi_malhotra — pricing/positioning bullets vs ArborAI & Nimbus.

I've dropped two attachments for reference: QBR_competitor_matrix_v2.xlsx (matrix of feature/pricing claims) and pricing-moves-summary.pdf (internal summary). Also added the working QBR folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_QBR. HubSpot note: HS-1234567890.

Timing: please add a first draft slide to the Drive folder by EOD Tue Oct 20. I want one consolidated deck by Thu Oct 22 COB for exec review.

Thanks — Vivek
-- 
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

I'll take the Product/Runtime mitigation slide. Initial bullets I want to include:
- Short-term: reduce conservative batching defaults for hosted API (A/B test on 20% of traffic), push KV cache warm-path improvements, enable cheaper model variant routing for long-tail workloads.
- Medium: automated quantization profiles + one-click deploy for INT8 family.
- Risk/Tradeoffs: narrower latency SLAs on cheaper routing; need comms plan with CS.

Request for data: Rishi or Karthik, can you add current baseline numbers for latency & cost-per-token for the models we run in hosted vs dedicated? That will help quantify the delta.

-markus

- CloudX 7B's early evals look good on instruction-following for <128 token outputs; not competitive on long-context or large-batch throughput.
